issues.description: The problem statement uses a snake_case method name 'get_total_number_of_students()' (line 41) while the UML, template TODOs, and solution use the camelCase 'getTotalNumberOfStudents()'. This naming inconsistency can confuse students about the exact method name and signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Update the problem statement to reference getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase) to match the UML, template TODOs, and the solution, or explicitly note the intended naming convention so students are not confused.
